title: POST /prices on one 8.99 item answers the documented amounts: 8.99, tax 0.56, total 9.55, with no guid assigned

source.note: The page: 'The /prices endpoint is the only reliable and supported way to determine the payment amount for a check'; the request is an Order with diningOption.guid and checks[0].selections[0].item.guid, quantity 1; the response example has checks[0].amount 8.99, taxAmount 0.56, totalAmount 9.55, selections[0].price 8.99 and tax 0.56, and guid null because nothing is persisted. The seeded Tomato Soup is priced 8.99 under the default 6.25% rate to reproduce it. The page's example also names itemGroup.guid, which this unit's seed does not require and the case omits.
